title: 第一卷 第7章 习武太特么费钱了第一卷 第8章 神龙九变
lines: 眼前的街道，和他想象之中，完全不同！
陈玄来到京城，就被安排来到了将军府，自此他没有出去过一次。
而他来的那一天，还是在夜里，对于周遭的环境都没有仔细的观察。
陈玄本以为，他身处古代，这里的建筑物，街道，估计和地球的古代，是差别不大的。
然而当他真正走上街的时候，他却被震撼到了。
将军府外面的街道，极为的宽阔整洁，两侧尽是高门大院，偶尔有着一些酒肆，这些酒肆看起来，比陈玄想象之中都要高端许多！
即便见过了现代的建筑物，此时的陈玄，也被眼前的景象有些震撼到了。
虽然很早，但是来往之人却不少。
陈玄也注意到，来往之人，要么身着华服，要么和陈玄一样，穿着一些下人的服饰。
显然，这条街道两侧所居住的，大概率都是这大周王朝的达官贵人。
他转身看去，他心中一顿！
在玄武大街的尽头，是气势磅礴的皇宫。
“皇宫么？”陈玄徐徐的吐了一口气道：“既然穿越来到了这个世界，如今虽是将军府下人一个，但是迟早有一天，我得去这辉煌的皇宫里看上一看！”
说着，他也不再停留，他紧了紧怀里的四十两银子，这笔钱，是他来到这个世界的启动资金，或许也是他翻身的资本！
“武者！”陈玄吐了一口气，然后朝着前方走去。
这个世界的一切对于陈玄都是新奇的，他既然来到了这个世界，自然要更多的去了解这个世界，遇到新奇的东西，他也会留下来多看一会儿。
穿过玄武大街之后，后面的街道，就没有这么宽阔了，但是陈玄估摸着，也足以相当于现代的四车道这么宽，只是街道的两侧，有着不少的小商贩！
其中贩卖各种各样东西的都有，包括摆地摊贩卖武器功法之类的。
当然了，这种地方，容易被敲竹杠，相较而言，陈玄还是觉得小红给他推荐的玄天阁更保险一些。
一路前行，不多时，他便看到了在左侧，一栋巨大的建筑物。
建筑物上，写着“玄天阁”三个大字。
陈玄发现，这个世界的文字和繁体字有着一些相似，他大概能够认出一个意思来。
看着这三个字，他心中微微一动。
习武！是陈玄在简单了解这个世界之后，最想要得到的东西。
他深吸了一口气，朝着店铺走了进去。
刚刚走入，一个热情的声音就响了起来道：“哟，小兄弟，您需要点儿什么？咱们这玄天阁，丹药武器，功法战技，应有尽有！”
陈玄抬眼看去，一个带着帽子，一身长衫，留着国字脸，八字胡的中年男子，正迎了过来。
“您是这儿的掌柜？”陈玄问道。
“对，免贵姓林！”中年男人微笑道。
毫无疑问，他就是小红口中的林掌柜了。
不过陈玄倒也没有说自己就是小红介绍过来的，杀熟这种事情，太正常不过了。
他干咳一声说道：“我需要一门武道功法！”
掌柜的眼睛微微一亮，然后他微笑道：“小哥这边请！”
说着，他带着陈玄走向了店铺之中，来到了几个柜子的前方，陈玄扫了一眼，一共有四个柜子，柜子上分别写着，玄阶初级，黄阶高级，黄阶中级和黄阶初级。

;;
The street in front of him was completely different from what he had imagined!
When Chen Xuan came to the capital, he was arranged to come to the General's Mansion. He has not been out once since then.
And the day he came, it was still at night, and he didn't observe the surrounding environment carefully.
Chen Xuan originally thought that he was in ancient times, and the buildings and streets here were probably not much different from the ancient times on earth.
But when he actually walked onto the street, he was shocked.
The street outside the General's Mansion was extremely wide and clean, with tall courtyards on both sides. There were occasionally some wine shops. These wine shops looked much more high-end than Chen Xuan had imagined!
Even though he had seen modern buildings, Chen Xuan was a little shocked by the sight in front of him.
Although it was early, there were many people coming and going.
Chen Xuan also noticed that the people coming and going were either wearing fancy clothes, or like Chen Xuan, wearing some servants' clothes.
Obviously, the people living on both sides of this street are most likely high-ranking officials of the Zhou Dynasty.
He turned around and looked, and he was heartbroken!
At the end of Xuanwu Street is the majestic Imperial Palace.
"Is it the palace?" Chen Xuan exhaled slowly and said, "Now that I have traveled through time and come to this world, even though I am now a servant of the General's Mansion, sooner or later, I have to go and take a look at this glorious palace!"
With that said, he stopped staying. He tightened the forty taels of silver in his arms. This money was the start-up capital for him to come to this world, and perhaps the capital for him to turn around!
"Warrior!" Chen Xuan breathed out and walked forward.
Everything in this world is novel to Chen Xuan. Since he has come to this world, he naturally wants to know more about it. When he encounters novel things, he will stay and look at them for a while.
After crossing Xuanwu Street, the street behind it is not so wide, but Chen Xuan estimates that it is as wide as a modern four-lane, but there are many small vendors on both sides of the street!
There are people selling all kinds of things, including setting up stalls selling weapons and techniques.
Of course, this kind of place is easy to be ripped off. In comparison, Chen Xuan still feels that the Xuantian Pavilion recommended to him by Xiao Hong is safer.
As he walked forward, he soon saw a huge building on the left.
On the building, there are three big characters written "Xuantian Pavilion".
Chen Xuan discovered that the characters in this world were somewhat similar to traditional Chinese characters, and he could probably recognize a meaning.
Looking at these three words, his heart moved slightly.
Practice martial arts! This is what Chen Xuan wants most after briefly understanding the world.
He took a deep breath and walked into the store.
As soon as he walked in, an enthusiastic voice rang out: "Hey, little brother, what do you need? Our Xuantian Pavilion has everything you need, including elixirs, weapons, martial arts and combat skills!"
Chen Xuan looked up and saw a middle-aged man wearing a hat, a long gown, a Chinese character face and a mustache, coming towards him.
"Are you the shopkeeper here?" Chen Xuan asked.
"Yes, your surname is Lin!" the middle-aged man said with a smile.
There is no doubt that he is the shopkeeper Lin mentioned by Xiao Hong.
However, Chen Xuan did not say that he was introduced by Xiao Hong. This kind of thing is too normal.
He coughed dryly and said, "I need a martial arts technique!"
The shopkeeper's eyes lit up slightly, and then he smiled and said, "Brother, please come this way!"
As he said that, he led Chen Xuan towards the store and came to several cabinets. Chen Xuan glanced at it and saw that there were four cabinets in total. The cabinets read respectively, Xuanjie Elementary, Huangjie Advanced, Huangjie Intermediate and Huangjie Elementary.
